asXii cursors

Every cursor the editor draws, numbered so you can point at one ("C07: the lasso tail is too long"). Each card shows the cursor big on a dark and a light background, with its click point (hotspot) as a red dot, and at real size on the right. Hover a card to try the real cursor.

Drawn in cursors.js on the toolbox icons' 20 × 20 grid, then scaled to 85% on a 24 × 24 image so a badge fits in the corner. The plan and checklist are in ascii-editor/CURSORS.md.
